pitch: Investigate the strange dome farm and solve crop clues using 'There is' and 'There are' to unlock the secret space setting.
targetFormula: There is a [singular] / There are [plural] on the farm.
topic: First Harvest story, indoor greenhouse on Mars, pink potatoes, purple corn, limited water, space suits, helmets

arc.discovery: Phase 1: Biosphere Scanner inspects the mysterious indoor greenhouse, scanning glowing plants and odd purple crops.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: Oxygen Workbench requires sorting singular and plural supplies, diagnosing crop problems, and assembling space sentences.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Airlock Stage teleprompter prompts student teams to present their Mars harvest report before suiting up.

mechanics: Whole-class smartboard arcade where teams take turns tapping large touch cards while desks signal singular (1 finger) or plural (2 fingers). Soft-fail plays a gentle airlock chime and highlights clue words without XP loss.

correct: The purple corn is growing fast! 🌽
softFail: Check the ending! Is there one or more than one? 💡
Look closely at the dome clue! 🔎
Remember: use 'There is' for ONE item! ☝️
Use 'There are' when counting many things! ✌️
Listen carefully to the spacesuit alert! 🎧
feedback.levelUp: Dome Airlock Unlocked! Level Up to Chief Mars Agronomist! 🏆

smartboard.boardActions: Team captain taps large 72px buttons, drags crops into singular/plural baskets, or clicks the oxygen intercom.
smartboard.classParticipation: Desk teams hold up 1 finger (There is) or 2 fingers (There are) before the board student touches the screen.
smartboard.version15min: 10 core rounds focusing on There is / There are sorting and Mars crop vocabulary.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round championship including setting deduction, listening alerts, and airlock speech challenges.

words.definition: A glass or plastic building where plants grow protected inside.
words.exampleSentence: The family grows vegetables in a greenhouse.

words.definition: Plants grown in large amounts for food.
words.exampleSentence: Their crops grew with bright colors.

words.definition: Feeling unhappy and afraid because of a problem.
words.exampleSentence: Dad was worried because water was limited.
Water on the base is limited.

words.definition: To feel sure that something is real or true.

words.exampleSentence: The green peppers had yellow stripes.

words.definition: Special protective clothing worn by astronauts in space.
words.exampleSentence: Put on your space suit before opening the door.

words.definition: A hard hat that protects the head and gives air.
words.exampleSentence: Check your helmet for fresh air.

words.definition: Where and when a story takes place.
words.exampleSentence: The surprise setting is the planet Mars!
